observations: Photo 0 shows a grey electric motor mounted under a white table, with a label that includes 'ELECTRIC MOTOR' and a red logo, possibly 'Lion'.
Photo 1 shows the full sewing stand: a white metal frame with a flat top surface, a black curved object (possibly a cover or part of a machine) on top, and the same motor visible under the table.
A foot pedal is visible on the floor in photo 1, connected to the motor by a wire.
The stand appears to be in a used condition with visible dust, stains, and some damage to the floor and wall around it.
The motor label in photo 0 is partially legible; the brand appears to be 'Lion' based on the red logo and context, but no model number is clearly readable.
The seller states there is no sewing machine, only the stand with working engine and pedal.

Photo of the second sewing stand if available.
Close-up of the pedal and its connection to the motor.
